{{Quote|To the castle that was once this planet's seat of government&hellip;until the Empire conquered this world, and depopulated it.|[[LE-914]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 80">[[Star Wars (1977) 80|''Star Wars'' (1977) 80]]</ref>}}
'''Dead Castle''' was a [[Castle/Legends|castle]] on an [[Dennaskar]]. It was formerly the seat of government for the populace for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, following the depopulation of the world, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took over the building, making it a base. At some point before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Tay Vanis]] crash-landed on the world in his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. After being captured, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] came to the planet and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] the man into a [[persistent vegetative state]].

Vader then placed the man into a small locked room, informing only the only local troops of Vanis' location. To the rest of the Imperials, Vader let them think that Vanis was still on the loose for his own purposes. With the false information, the Dark Lord was able to keep several of his more aggressive officers busy, as well as keeping many rebel agents out of the way as they searched for a man that was already in the Imperial's possession. Vader placed an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Dennaskar)|Imperial officer]] in charge of the castle and placed a prerecorded [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] near the door of the small locked room to taunt anyone that was able to find the planet where Vanis had crashed.

Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] came to the world and infiltrated the castle, discovering Vanis' comatose body. Vanis' droid [[LE-914]] self-destructed near her master, killing them both. As the Rebels left the castle, Skywalker sabotaged the buildings main power station. As they departed in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the castle exploded, making a lasting monument to the Rebel spy.
